title: Kestrel and the Bakery
author: Juniper Okafor
blurb: Paloma Ravensworth, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
